prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit and compositing.
Asset type: one coherent, full-bleed 1024×1536 portrait rendered background for an animated claw machine in a cozy winter train.
Input image 1 is the layout/material edit target: blue enamel outer cabinet, warm brass ceiling and deep side walls. Input image 2 is the arcade carriage that must be seen naturally THROUGH its glass. Input image 3 is a physical modelling reference for a real thick cabinet and sloped control ledge; do not copy its controls, joystick, delivery hatch or legs.
Create ONE spatially coherent three-dimensional scene, with a shared camera, perspective, shadows and lighting. Keep the upper cabinet framing, warm inset ceiling and blue/brass materials close to image 1. The camera is frontal at chamber eye height: side walls converge toward the rear and the control ledge below eye level has a clearly visible upper surface.
REDESIGN THE LOWER 45%: remove the shallow empty tray and any visible horizontal floor. Inside the chamber there is a recessed deep collection well, with narrow interior side returns descending into natural dark occlusion, not a flat black rectangle. The lower rear frame should disappear into the well's shadow around 64–70% image height. No prizes or claw are visible.
A real thick BLUE ENAMEL CONTROL CONSOLE is structurally joined to the two cabinet pillars. Its sloping upper deck occupies roughly 70–77% of image height, with a back edge visibly deeper and narrower than its front edge, substantial rounded brass/blue front lip, chamfered corners, visible side cheeks and warm highlights on the exposed top plane. Its broad vertical front fascia from about 77% to the bottom is blank blue enamel for overlay app controls, with subtle curvature, bevels and physically cast shadows. The console should feel like a solid projecting arcade cabinet, never an enlarged flat strip pasted across the image. Keep the flat usable front area almost the full width (3–97%).
The arcade carriage from image 2 appears behind and through the upper/rear and side glass, with the SAME perspective and light as the cabinet. Add restrained glass reflections and slight refraction, not milky white panes, a printed wallpaper or a second claw machine.
Preserve the soft polished low-poly/voxel-like 3D illustration style, original navy/cobalt enamel, gold brass and warm cream lighting. The interior needs visible perspective, thickness, overlapping surfaces, contact shadows and a deep dark recess.
No claw assembly, cable, prize, buttons, joystick, coin slot, text, logos, people, outer margins, lower delivery hatch or feet. UI and claw are added as separate layers. Fully opaque coherent scene, not transparency or checkerboard.
